page_title: LAZ 2-1 CAG | Lazio v Cagliari 04/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Giovanni Ayroldi is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Cagliari fail to score from a corner as Ivan Provedel (Lazio) leaps to collect the ball.
90+5' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The ball is out of play. Cagliari will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+3' Unbelievable miss! Pedro (Lazio) reacts superbly to latch on to a rebound, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.

90+2' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Simone Scuffet inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the bottom left corner, but was denied by a great save.
90+1' Pedro (Lazio) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
88' Wonderful movement by Lazio. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
85' Giovanni Ayroldi shows a yellow card to Nicolo Rovella (Lazio), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
84' Davide Nicola prepares a substitution. Roberto Piccoli is replaced by Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari).
84' A substitution has been made. Zito Luvumbo goes off and Jose Luis Palomino (Cagliari) comes on.
83' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
81' Marco Baroni has decided to substitute Manuel Lazzari and he is replaced by Adam Marusic (Lazio).
80' The referee allows time for a substitution. Boulaye Dia will be replaced by Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio).

78' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) is given a second yellow card for his behaviour. He said too much to the referee and Giovanni Ayroldi sent him off. One can only wonder what was going on his head. He has weakened his team.
78' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.
78' Here comes a substitution. Mattia Felici (Cagliari) is brought on as a substitute for Nadir Zortea.
76' 2 - 1 Goal! Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Simone Scuffet.
76' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
76' A player from Cagliari takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY! A huge scoring opportunity for Lazio.
74' Giovanni Ayroldi shows the yellow card to Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) for a heavy challenge.
73' Substitution. Matteo Guendouzi leaves the pitch and is replaced by Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio).
73' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) tries to play a long through ball into Taty Castellanos, but the defence breaks the move down.
71' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
69' Referee Giovanni Ayroldi sees the trip by Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
68' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Adam Obert (Cagliari) replacing Tommaso Augello.
68' Substitution. Gianluca Gaetano is replaced by Nicolas Viola (Cagliari).

65' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) collects the ball from the free kick and immediately sends his close-range effort narrowly wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
64' Giovanni Ayroldi shows a yellow card to Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) for a tough tackle.
63' Marco Baroni decides to make a substitution. Gustav Isaksen will be replaced by Pedro (Lazio).
62' The defensive wall stood firm and easily blocked the powerfully hit free kick from Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) on the edge of the box.
61' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Giovanni Ayroldi didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
61' A perfect long pass by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) finds Matias Vecino. He latches on to the pass and continues his attacking run.
59' Lazio quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
59' Matias Vecino (Lazio) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. Now Lazio have a corner.
57' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Giovanni Ayroldi who sees an offensive foul. Lazio get a free kick.
54' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.

54' Lazio slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
53' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
52' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Simone Scuffet intercepts the ball.
52' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The linesman signals a throw-in for Cagliari.
51' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
49' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Giovanni Ayroldi ignores the protests.
48' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
47' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Lazio earn a free kick.
47' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Marco Baroni probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Tijjani Noslin. He is replaced by Matias Vecino (Lazio).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Cagliari are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Taty Castellanos latches onto a perfect defence-splitting pass from Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) and heads towards goal.

44' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
41' 1 - 1 Goal! Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Ivan Provedel. He makes it 1:1.
40' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Tommaso Augello (Cagliari), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
37' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) whips the ball into the box and Yerry Mina takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept.
37' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.

36' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the bottom left corner is thwarted by Ivan Provedel. The referee points to the corner flag and Cagliari will take a corner.
35' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
33' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

33' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lazio.
31' Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
29' The foul by Yerry Mina (Cagliari) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Giovanni Ayroldi.
29' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Simone Scuffet comes off his line to intercept.
27' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. That's a free kick to Lazio.
26' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Gustav Isaksen, but Simone Scuffet displays great awareness to stop him.
25' Today's referee Giovanni Ayroldi rightly decides to book Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) for his harsh tackle.
25' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
24' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
24' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) sends a chip pass into the box, but Ivan Provedel is quickest to intercept the ball.
21' The foul by Taty Castellanos (Lazio) was seen by Giovanni Ayroldi who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

19' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) received a fine pass and tried his luck from long range. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Simone Scuffet pulled off a great save to push the ball onto the post.

18' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) gets to the rebound but blows his chance to score with a header from a dangerous position inside the box. His effort floats high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
17' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) receives a yellow card.
17' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
16' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is behind the touchline and Cagliari will take a throw-in.
15' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
14' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move. A free kick to Cagliari.
13' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
10' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
9' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
9' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cagliari.
8' CHANCE! Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
2' 1 - 0 Boulaye Dia (Lazio) takes a great first touch inside the box after the free kick, wins himself some space and beats the goalkeeper with an accurate strike into the right side of the target.
1' Poor challenge! Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is penalised for tripping and Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle. Lazio have a free kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Cagliari will have the kick-off.
Giovanni Ayroldi was nominated as the referee for this game.
